newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ABB sets up j/v in Vietnam with THIBIDI.
newsitem.headline: ABB sets up j/v in Vietnam with THIBIDI.

text.p: International engineering group ABB said on Tuesday that it has set up a joint venture in Vietnam with THIBIDI, owned by the Vietnamese Industry Ministry.
ABB said in a statement that the joint venture will have 380 staff and will make components for power distribution.
The joint venture company, ABB Transformers and Switchgear Ltd, will be owned 65 percent by ABB and the rest by THIBIDI.
"The new joint venture company is the first electro-technical company to be established in Ho Chi Minh," ABB said.
